start: Owner in Messages & offers > Workout offer; gym online; no offer running

steps.action: Open the page
user_sees: "Start a workout offer" with Workouts 10, Within 30 days, Reward 3 days, a "Members can join until" day 30 days ahead
must_not: The form while another offer is running

steps.action: Pick under "How the days are given": "I give them (the desk gives with one tap)"
user_sees: "When a member reaches the target, they show as “Ready for reward”. The owner or the front desk gives the days with one tap."
"No receipt and no GST: free days are not a sale."
must_not: Both choices pressed

steps.action: Read "What members see"
user_sees: "Train 10 times in 30 days, get 3 extra days"
"Check in at the gym and log a workout of 20+ minutes with 6+ sets."
must_not: Words that differ from the numbers typed

steps.action: Tap "Start offer"
user_sees: "Starting…" on the button, then "Offer started. Members see it in the MettleUp app now."
A card with "Running" and "Joined 0 · Ready 0 · Rewarded 0"
must_not: Two offers started by two taps
The form still shown under the running offer

start: Other way in: the Today card, when one member has reached the target

steps.action: Open Today
user_sees: A card "Workout offer": "1 reward to give" with a button "Give"
must_not: The card with nothing to give
"1 rewards to give"
A reward the owner took back counted

steps.action: Tap "Give"
user_sees: The Workout offer page with the member marked "Ready for reward"
must_not: The reward given by this tap alone

steps.action: Tap "Give 3 days" on the member
user_sees: "Giving…", then "3 days added for <name>. New last day: <date>."
The member now "Rewarded": "Extended free by 3 days (reward) · by <who> · new last day <date>"
must_not: Days added twice
A receipt or GST line made for the free days
The Today card still saying 1 to give

start: Owner on the start form, then on a member with no running plan, then with the gym not online

steps.action: Type Workouts 3
user_sees: "Workouts: a whole number from 4 to 30."
"Start offer" cannot be pressed
must_not: An offer started with numbers out of range

steps.action: Type Workouts 20, Within 10
user_sees: "At most one workout counts a day: give more days than workouts."
must_not: The offer started

steps.action: Type Reward 8, then pick a join day 4 months ahead
user_sees: "Reward: a whole number of days from 1 to 7."
"Members can join until: today or a day in the next 90 days."
must_not: A silent correction of the numbers

steps.action: Tap "Give" for a member whose plan has ended
user_sees: "No gym plan running. Give it when they renew."
must_not: Days added to an ended plan
The reward marked given

steps.action: Open the page in a gym whose records are not online
user_sees: "Workout offers need your gym online" and why
must_not: A form that saves nowhere

start: Owner with a running offer and one member "Rewarded"

steps.action: Tap "Take back" on the member and say yes to "Take back the 3 reward days from <name>? Their plan's last day goes back."
user_sees: "Reward taken back. Last day: <old date>."
The member reads "Reward taken back"
must_not: The plan's last day unchanged
A day lost that the member had before the reward
The take-back done without the question

steps.action: Tap "Give 3 days" on the same member again
user_sees: "3 days added for <name>. ..."
must_not: A refusal for the owner

steps.action: Change "How the days are given" to by themselves
user_sees: "The days are now given by themselves."
must_not: Rewards already waiting given twice

steps.action: Tap "Stop offer" and say yes to "Stop this offer? Nobody new can join. Members already in keep their days to finish."
user_sees: "Offer stopped. Members already in can still finish."
The card reads "Stopped"; the start form is back
must_not: Members already in losing their progress
Rewards already given taken away

steps.action: After the join day passes on a running offer, open the page
user_sees: The card reads "Joining closed"
must_not: "Running" when nobody can join

start: Owner reading the list of members in a running offer

steps.action: Read one member's line
user_sees: "6 of 10 workouts · desk 5 · app 1 · until <date>"
must_not: What the member trained, weights or times (the phone sends only the dates)
Members who did not tap "Join the offer"

steps.action: Give a reward and open the member's payments
user_sees: No new receipt
must_not: A receipt, a sale or GST for the free days

steps.action: Read the list as a member in the member app
user_sees: unknown
must_not: Other members' names or progress shown to a member (not checked in this pass)

start: Front-desk sign-in; the owner started an offer where the desk gives the days; one member is "Ready for reward"

steps.action: Open the Workout offer page (Messages & offers > Workout offer)
user_sees: The offer card: "Running", "The desk gives the days with one tap."
The member "Ready for reward" with "Give 3 days"
must_not: The start form
"Stop offer", "Take back" or the choice of how days are given

steps.action: Tap "Give 3 days"
user_sees: "3 days added for <name>. New last day: <date>."
The line now names who gave it
must_not: Days added twice
A receipt made

start: Other way in for the desk: the Today card

steps.action: Open Today when two rewards wait
user_sees: "Workout offer": "2 rewards to give" and "Give"
must_not: unknown: whether a desk sign-in gets this card was not checked

steps.action: Tap "Give"
user_sees: The Workout offer page
must_not: A page the desk cannot open

start: Front-desk sign-in; no offer running; later a reward the owner took back

steps.action: Open the Workout offer page with no offer
user_sees: "No workout offer running": "The owner starts one in Messages & offers."
must_not: A way for the desk to start an offer

steps.action: With an offer running, look at a member whose reward the owner took back
user_sees: "Reward taken back" and no Give button
must_not: The desk giving back what the owner took away

steps.action: Two desk people tap "Give 3 days" for the same member at the same moment
user_sees: One: "3 days added ..."; the other: "<name> already has the reward. New last day: <date>."
must_not: Six days added

steps.action: Tap "Give" when the member's plan was changed since they earned it
user_sees: "Their plan changed since; change the days by hand with Freeze / extra days."
must_not: A wrong last day saved

start: Front-desk sign-in, a running offer, one member moving through the states

steps.action: Look at a member who joined
user_sees: "In the offer" and "<n> of 10 workouts · ... · until <date>"
must_not: A Give button before the target

steps.action: Look again after the member reaches 10
user_sees: "Ready for reward" with "Give 3 days"
must_not: More than "10 of 10" shown

steps.action: Give it; look again
user_sees: "Rewarded" with "Extended free by 3 days (reward) · by <desk name> · new last day <date>"
must_not: A second Give button

steps.action: Look at a member whose window passed without the target, and one who left
user_sees: "Window over"; "Left the offer"
must_not: A Give button on either
